Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time today. As we discussed, I want to put the next steps and a short contingency/runbook in one place so finance can reflect the most likely commit for the July forecast. We are trying to avoid an unexpected commit swing on the Q3 book.

High-level ask: can KiteLogix confirm the requested items by EOD next Monday (Aug 2)? If we get these in the window I can keep the deal in "Yellow (At-risk but targeted)" for commit — otherwise forecasting will move it to Red for planning.

Required items for Yellow -> Commit:
- Signed PO or confirmed purchase order email from procurement@kitelogix.com
- Final SOW signature (DocuSign)
- Completion of low-risk security questionnaire (we have the draft answers)
- Technical go/no-go by your infra lead (short checklist)

What Redwood will do if items arrive on time:
- Hold pricing in quote_KiteLogix_20260727.pdf for 14 days
- Provide onboarding credits (two-week pilot credits) as a one-time concession to reduce time-to-value
- Prioritize provisioning to meet your Aug go-live target

I've attached a short runbook (Q3_contingency_runbook.xlsx) and a mutual action plan (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_Q3.xlsx) that maps owners and due dates. Please confirm who will own the PO and who will sign the SOW so we can update the HubSpot deal and the forecast.

Attachments: Q3_contingency_runbook.xlsx (runbook), MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_Q3.xlsx (owners/due dates), quote_KiteLogix_20260727.pdf
